reason: Spec allows null for this field but the SDK models it non-optional. Pre-existing across this SDK for fields the API practically always populates on a successful/terminal response (quote quotations, computed amounts, pagination cursors, tracking sub-object step). Changing the property to Optional is a breaking public type change for existing consumers, so it needs its own deliberate PR rather than a silent widening here.

Spec declares this field as an integer (smallest-unit, e.g. cents) but the SDK models it as Double (major-unit, e.g. dollars) with a hand-rolled or absent unit conversion, matching this SDK's existing per-field amount-unit convention (see the survey: request_amount on Create*QuoteInput converts dollars->cents in a hand-rolled encode(to:); CreateTransferQuoteInput.requestAmount and FeeOptions' rate fields do not convert at all and pass the Double through as-is). Pre-existing, not introduced by this PR; changing the public type is a deliberate decision for its own PR.
